title: Focus Mode (Distraction-Free Writing)
description: Implement focus mode that hides sidebar and panels, expanding the editor to full width with smooth transitions
action: Create src/stores/uiSlice.ts with: State type { focusMode: boolean }, Actions type { toggleFocusMode: () => void; setFocusMode: (on: boolean) => void }. Use create*Slice pattern from existing slices (see backendSlice.ts). Add uiSlice to appStore.ts following the existing slice composition pattern. Add focus mode toggle button (keyboard icon or expand icon) in the editor area header. Add global keydown listener for Escape key that calls setFocusMode(false). When focusMode is true: add CSS class 'focus-mode' to the main layout container that hides sidebar and intelligence panels via Tailwind responsive utilities (hidden class). Add transition-all duration-300 for smooth animation. On entering focus mode, remember panel states; on exiting, restore them.

criteria: grep -r 'focusMode' src/ returns at least 3 file matches
convergence.verification: Run npx vitest run. Verify uiSlice test passes. Check that focusMode toggle can be called from components.
convergence.definition_of_done: Focus mode can be toggled via store action, Escape key exits focus mode, sidebar and panels hide when active

files.change: New Zustand slice with focusMode: boolean (default false), toggleFocusMode action, setFocusMode(boolean) action
Import createUiSlice from ./uiSlice, add UiSlice to AppState type, add createUiSlice to store creation
Add useEffect for Escape key listener when focusMode is active. Add focus mode toggle button in editor header area.

implementation: Create src/stores/uiSlice.ts following the pattern in src/stores/app/backendSlice.ts
Define UiSliceActions { toggleFocusMode: () => void; setFocusMode: (on: boolean) => void }
Export createUiSlice as StateCreator<AppState, [], [], UiSliceState & UiSliceActions>
In appStore.ts: import createUiSlice, add UiSlice to AppState intersection type, add createUiSlice to store creation
In the main editor layout component: use useAppStore(s => s.focusMode) to conditionally hide sidebar/panels
Add a toggle button (keyboard shortcut F11 or button with Maximize2 icon) in the editor area
Add useEffect with document.addEventListener('keydown') for Escape key → setFocusMode(false)
Add 'focus-mode' CSS handling: when focusMode is true, add className to hide sidebar and panels with transition
Run: npx vitest run to verify no regressions

unit: uiSlice: initial state has focusMode false
uiSlice: setFocusMode(true) sets focusMode to true
uiSlice: setFocusMode(false) sets focusMode to false

reference.examples: See createBackendSlice for the exact slice creation pattern

rationale.chosen_approach: Zustand slice for global state, Escape key for exit, CSS transitions for smooth UX
decision_factors: Locked decision: focus mode in Zustand store (context.md #3)
Global layout state needs cross-component access
Escape key is standard for exiting modes
rationale.tradeoffs: Adds global keydown listener — must be cleaned up on unmount

risks: Focus mode state conflicts with panel open/close — mitigated by remembering panel states on enter, restoring on exit
